title: Exquisite Briny Middle Eastern Lamb Kibbeh
description: A traditional Middle Eastern dish featuring lamb leg, served in a briny and molten kibbeh form, perfect for a comforting meal. This halal-friendly recipe is sure to become a favorite.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the ground lamb, bulgur, onion, spices, salt, and black pepper, mixing well.
Gradually add the olive oil and lemon juice to the lamb mixture, stirring until just combined.
Add the water to the mixture and stir until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and pliable.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and shape each into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the kibbeh for 25 minutes or until cooked through.
While the kibbeh is baking, prepare the deglaze fond by heating 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Add 2 cloves of minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add 1 cup of chicken broth to the skillet and bring to a boil, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan.
